title: 98% on-time claim and proposed advertising campaign at Harlow & Vane Freight Lines

organization.size: approx. 1,150 staff; 14 terminals; about 400 linehaul and pickup-and-delivery drivers; 34 dispatchers in three dispatch centers (Northgate, Riverside, Pell Junction)

presentingRequest: Our on-time delivery rate hit 98.1% in Q3, up from 91.4% a year ago. That is the best number in our region and we want to tell the market. We plan to launch a '98 out of 100, on time' campaign on 12 January 2027, and we want to lift the top tier of the dispatcher on-time bonus to reward 99% so we keep improving. We'd like your help substantiating the claim for the campaign and setting the new bonus targets. - CEO, Harlow & Vane Freight Lines

evidence.text: 'RouteWise was the game changer. We put the route-optimization system in early this year and the bonus made the dispatchers own the number. We went from 91.4% on time in Q3 last year to 98.1% this Q3. Marketing has a $420,000 campaign ready for 12 January. I want the top bonus tier raised from $900 a quarter at 98% to $1,500 a quarter at 99%. Customers aren't complaining to me; our account reps tell me the big accounts are happy.'

'Date revisions are legitimate. Mostly they're customer requests or weather, and we're simply being proactive - if we can see a load is going to slip, we reset the promise and the customer knows where they stand. RouteWise has also helped us a lot with planning. People who say we're fiddling the number don't understand dispatch.'

evidence.source: TMS on-time KPI definition (Operations Data Standards, rev. 2023-04)
evidence.text: 'On-time delivery % = shipments delivered on or before the current Promised Delivery Date / shipments delivered. The Promised Delivery Date may be revised by a dispatcher at any time before delivery by selecting a reason code (Customer Request, Weather, Operational - Capacity, Other). The revised date replaces the original date for all KPI purposes; the original date is retained only in the revision log. A revised-ETA email is sent to the customer only if the dispatcher ticks Notify Customer.'

evidence.source: TMS promised-date revision log summary, Jan 2025 - Sep 2026 (extract by Operations data analyst, 2026-11-05)
evidence.text: Revisions per 100 shipments, network: 2025 average 2.9; Jan-Feb 2026 2.8; Mar-Sep 2026 14.1 (5.0x Jan-Feb). Reason-code mix Jan-Feb 2026 vs Mar-Sep 2026: Customer Request 58% vs 13%; Weather 17% vs 6%; Operational - Capacity 22% vs 74%; Other 3% vs 7% (Customer Request revisions per 100 shipments: 1.6 vs 1.8). Share of revisions entered after 12:00 on the original promised date or later: 12% vs 44%. Share of revisions with Notify Customer ticked: 61% vs 18%.

evidence.source: Dispatcher On-Time Incentive Plan (HR policy document, approved 2026-02-10)
evidence.text: Quarterly bonus per dispatcher based on the on-time delivery % (TMS definition) of the dispatcher's assigned lanes: $300 at 95% or more, $600 at 97% or more, $900 at 98% or more. Effective 2026-03-01 for Northgate and Riverside dispatchers. Pell Junction dispatchers, covered by a collective agreement, become eligible 2026-07-01 after the agreement amendment was ratified on 2026-06-12. No change to revision permissions or reason-code rules accompanied the plan.

evidence.source: TMS revision log by dispatch center, monthly, Jan-Sep 2026
evidence.text: Revisions per 100 shipments. Northgate: Jan 2.7, Feb 2.9, then Mar-Sep monthly range 15.9-18.6. Riverside: Jan 2.6, Feb 3.0, then Mar-Sep monthly range 15.2-18.1. Pell Junction: Jan-Jun monthly range 2.9-3.5; Jul 13.8, Aug 14.9, Sep 15.1.

evidence.source: Reported on-time delivery % by dispatch center (TMS KPI dashboard), Jan 2025 - Sep 2026
evidence.text: 2025: all three centers between 90.2% and 92.4% in every month. 2026: Northgate Jan-Feb 91.0%, Mar-Sep 97.2-98.6%. Riverside Jan-Feb 90.6%, Mar-Sep 97.5-98.8%. Pell Junction Jan-Jun 90.9-92.1%, Jul-Sep 97.9-98.5%. Network Q3 2026: 98.1% (Q3 2025: 91.4%).

evidence.source: RouteWise implementation record (IT project office closeout report, 2026-10-30)
evidence.text: RouteWise route optimization went live at the Riverside and Pell Junction dispatch centers on 2026-02-09. Northgate go-live was delayed by a data-migration defect and occurred on 2026-10-19. Measured benefit at live sites, Feb-Sep 2026 vs prior year: linehaul miles per shipment down 5.8%, fuel cost per shipment down 4.9%. The report records no on-time benefit target and no on-time analysis.

evidence.source: Customer service complaint log, Mar-Sep 2025 vs Mar-Sep 2026 (CRM extract)
evidence.text: Lateness complaints: 412 vs 556 (+35%). By period: Mar-May 171 vs 232 (+36%); Jun-Sep 241 vs 324 (+34%). Damage complaints: 188 vs 191 (+2%). Billing complaints: 240 vs 233 (-3%). Shipments delivered: 412,300 vs 428,800 (+4.0%). All three complaint categories can be filed by phone, email or (from 2026-06-15) the customer portal.

'The jump in complaints is the portal. Since we launched it in June with a one-click Report a Problem button, people log things they would never have bothered to phone about. It's a good thing - more visibility - but it doesn't mean service got worse.'

evidence.source: Logistics manager, Brightwell Home Supply (largest customer by revenue; interview and receiving-dock log extract shared 2026-11-06)
evidence.text: Brightwell's receiving logs for Jul-Sep 2026: 1,946 Harlow & Vane shipments, 1,576 (81.0%) received on or before the originally booked appointment date; Brightwell's equivalent figure for Q3 2025 was 87%. Harlow & Vane's Q3 2026 scorecard sent to Brightwell reported 98.4% on time. Of the 1,946 shipments, 311 had a revised promised date in Harlow & Vane's system; Brightwell's records show it requested 46 of those changes. 'We were told about very few of the others. We're putting 30% of our lanes out to tender at the Q1 review.'

evidence.source: Anonymous dispatcher pulse survey (HR, September 2026; 29 of 34 dispatchers responded)
evidence.text: 72% (21) agree 'There is pressure to revise promised dates to protect the on-time number.' 17% (5) say they have raised a concern about date revisions with a supervisor. Comments include: 'If you don't reset it, you're the one who loses the bonus and you drag the whole lane down'; 'Nobody asks whether the freight actually got there when the customer wanted it'; 'Supervisors say protect the number at the morning call.'

'When a trailer is stuck at Ashford because we've got no driver for the second leg, I know it's going to be a day late. Resetting the date is just being honest about it - why should I lose my bonus for a driver shortage I can't fix? We're definitely shorter on drivers on the mountain lanes this year than last.'

evidence.source: HR driver headcount and terminal analysis (HR and Operations analyst memo, 2026-11-07)
evidence.text: Driver headcount 412 on 2026-01-01, 401 on 2026-09-30; driver vacancy rate 6.1% to 9.4%. Across the 14 terminals, Q3 2026 driver vacancy rate correlates with Q3 2026 promised-date revision rate (r = 0.58). The four highest-vacancy terminals (Ashford, Kettle Falls, Dunmore, Ostrander) are the four terminals serving the long mountain lanes, and they also had the four highest revision rates in Q3 2025, when vacancy was 7% or below at every terminal. Analyst note: 'Not adjusted for lane length or freight mix. Delivery timeliness against the original promised date was not analysed.'

evidence.source: Weather disruption days from state DOT road-closure and advisory records, compiled by Safety department
evidence.text: Days with a closure or travel advisory affecting two or more Harlow & Vane terminals: Mar-Sep 2025: 14; Mar-Sep 2026: 11.

evidence.source: Finance payroll record, dispatcher on-time bonus payouts
evidence.text: Q2 2026: 23 eligible dispatchers (Northgate, Riverside), 20 at the $900 tier and 3 at $600; total $19,800. Q3 2026: 34 eligible dispatchers, 31 at the $900 tier and 3 at $600; total $29,700.

hypotheses.text: The rise in reported on-time delivery from about 91% to 98% reflects a real improvement in how reliably freight arrives when customers were originally promised it.
The reported on-time metric conceals a deterioration in actual delivery timeliness against the original commitments made to customers.
The increase in promised-date revisions is largely dispatchers responding to the on-time bonus by moving the target date, rather than more customer-requested or weather-driven changes.
The RouteWise route-optimization rollout is the main driver of the increase in reported on-time delivery.
The 35% rise in lateness complaints is an artifact of the new customer portal making complaints easier to file, not a change in service.
Any underlying deterioration in delivery timeliness is driven primarily by the driver shortage.

actions.text: Launch the '98 out of 100, on time' advertising campaign on 12 January 2027 as planned, using the TMS on-time figure as substantiation.
Raise the dispatcher bonus top tier to $1,500 per quarter at 99% on-time (current TMS definition).

Suspend external use of the 98% figure and recompute on-time delivery against the original promised date from the revision log (Jan 2025 onward), cross-checked against receiving records from large customers, with an audit of revision reason codes, timing and customer notification.

Re-base the dispatcher incentive on on-time performance against the original committed date and let a revised promised date replace the original in the KPI only when the revision is documented as customer-initiated or tied to a logged external disruption; other expected delays are still sent to the customer as a revised ETA.
Approve an emergency $2.1M plan to hire 35 additional linehaul drivers and lease 20 tractors to restore on-time performance.

evidenceRequests.text: Network-wide on-time delivery recomputed against the original promised date, monthly, Jan 2025 - Sep 2026, by dispatch center
Terminal-level original-date misses analysed against driver vacancy, linehaul tender rejections, and lane length/freight mix
Proof-of-delivery timestamps matched to customer appointment records for the top 20 accounts, 2025 vs 2026
Marketing agency's draft creative and media plan for the January campaign
RouteWise vendor's published case-study ROI brochure
Sales team interviews on account-level customer sentiment
